cumleler: Can there be severe cochlear loss when emissions are present?
With cochlear loss above thirty to forty decibels, OAEs are usually absent.
Reported severe cochlear loss in an ear with clear emissions is inconsistent.
An acoustic reflex very close to the reported threshold also contradicts it.
Still, the decision rests on all the findings, not on one test.
